pagerduty: :rotating_light: P1 - model-catalog-updates - page triggered for failed model promotion (INC12345)
pagerduty: Trigger reason: post-promotion validation errors; high rate of inference failures for some customers. Link: https://pagerduty.example/INC12345
incident-bot: Created incident channel #incident-INC12345 and notified rotation @eng-oncall. Escalation level: primary -> secondary after 5m.
alice-m: Acked. I'm pulling logs and config.
ben-s: I'm primary oncall, on it. Any customer-facing error examples?
eve-support: Multiple customers reporting 500s with payloads containing non-ascii chars. Error seen in logs: "tokenizer mismatch: expected bpe-v1, got bpe-v2". Several support tickets opened (CS-987, CS-988).
carla: Observability: catalog promoted default revision m-abc@v2.1.4 at 2026-03-14T18:03:20Z. Canary looked OK for a tiny sample but error rate spiked after wider rollout.
carla: quick log snippet from model router:```
2026-03-14T18:04:12Z ERROR route=prod model=m-abc rev=v2.1.4 request_id=xyz tokenizer_check_failed: field "tokenizer" mismatch (bpe-v2 vs bpe-v1)
stack: validate_default_revision -> apply_defaults -> tokenizer::compare
```
alice-m: That matches support reports. Looks like the revision advertised a different tokenizer metadata than catalog expects. Might be a metadata-only mismatch, but runtime rejects.
dave-oncall: Pager acknowledged by ben-s (ben-s). (reacted :eyes:)
ben-s: Plan: 1) Pause further promotions, 2) Rollback default tag for m-abc to v2.1.3, 3) Route affected traffic to fallback variant with tokenizer=bpe-v1, 4) Post incident update to status.redwood.ai. Executing step 2 now.
ben-s: Running admin command: `redwoodctl catalog promote --model m-abc --rev v2.1.3 --tag default --force`
incident-bot: Promotion rollback job started (job id jb-773).
carla: Metrics: requests with tokenizer mismatch peaked at 6.2% of prod traffic at 18:06 UTC. Error budget crossing threshold.
ben-s: Admin API returned 202, rollback started. Monitoring traffic shift.
ben-s: Confirmed: default now m-abc@v2.1.3. (reacted :white_check_mark: by dave-oncall)
dave-oncall: Error rate down to baseline within 90s of rollback. 5xx rate back to 0.4% from 6.2%. Latency unchanged.
eve-support: Updating customers: posting incident note to status page and sending brief to impacted accounts.
alice-m: Root-cause quick analysis: the catalog promotion pipeline upstream allowed revisions whose manifest tokenizer field is present but not validated against the router's expected tokenizer enum. v2.1.4 introduced tokenizer metadata "bpe-v2" (new internal tokenizer) but router runtime only understands "bpe-v1" canonical tag. Pre-promotion canary didn't include non-ascii payloads so it missed the mismatch.
carla: Short-term mitigation: block promotions that change tokenizer field without explicit compatibility flag; add a pre-promote validation that runs tokenizer smoke test with representative payloads.
ben-s: I'm documenting immediate follow-ups: - block auto-promo on tokenizer changes (owner: eng-platform @carla), - add e2e canary suite including unicode payloads (owner: devex @alice-m), - add a catalog invariant test in CI (owner: eng-ml @ben-s).
carla: Created tasks: PLAT-541 (block tokenizer change), CANARY-212 (unicode/e2e), CI-989 (manifest schema strict).
alice-m: Quick mitigation PR ready for platform to gate promotions, will push after CI.
dave-oncall: Confirmed no remaining customer error spikes in last 10m. Will keep page open until follow-ups scheduled.
eve-support: Posting final interim update to customers: "A subset of requests experienced failures due to a model metadata mismatch. Traffic has been rolled back to a stable revision and error rates have returned to normal. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline for fixes."
ben-s: Closing the on-call loop: handing back to rotation (primary cleared). I'll start the incident write-up in the postmortem doc.
incident-bot: Incident INC12345 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned owners: carla, alice-m, ben-s.
carla: Postmortem outline: timeline, impact (customers affected: 4 orgs; peak error rate 6.2%), root cause, fixes, verification, follow-ups. I'll draft and ping for reviews.
alice-m: Noting automation improvement: add catalog manifest lint in pre-commit for model ops.
ben-s: Thx all. If anyone sees anomalies, re-open. (reacted :thumbsup:)
